label: Grant material access subject to ownership/API-context RLS

execute.sql: GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON TABLE public."SourceMaterial" TO authenticated

precheck.description: ensure RLS policy "source_material_insert_api_own_bbb50d09" does not exist
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"

execute.sql: CREATE POLICY "source_material_insert_api_own_bbb50d09" ON "public"."SourceMaterial" AS PERMISSIVE FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (((current_setting('learnly.api_write', true) = '1') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "LearningSession" s JOIN "User" u ON u.id = s."userId" WHERE s.id = "SourceMaterial"."learningSessionId" AND u."authUserId" = (SELECT auth.uid())::text)))

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"
